pitch_mean_midi.rationale: Arithmetic mean of MIDI note numbers.

pitch_std_midi.rationale: Standard deviation of MIDI note numbers.

pitch_class_entropy.rationale: Shannon entropy across 12 chromatic pitch classes.

pitch_class_count.rationale: Number of distinct pitch classes present.

interval_std_abs_semitones.rationale: Standard deviation of melodic interval sizes.

interval_leap_ratio.rationale: Ratio of melodic leaps (> 2 semitones) to all intervals.

interval_step_ratio.rationale: Ratio of stepwise intervals (1-2 semitones) to all intervals.

interval_unison_ratio.rationale: Ratio of pitch repetitions to all intervals.

rhythm_duration_mean.rationale: Mean note attack duration in quarter lengths.

rhythm_duration_std.rationale: Standard deviation of note attack durations.

rhythm_duration_range_ratio.rationale: Ratio of longest to shortest duration.

density_events_per_measure.rationale: Mean note+rest event count per measure.

density_notes_per_quarter.rationale: Note attack density per quarter note pulse.

density_rest_ratio.rationale: Rest duration fraction of total duration.

density_voice_count.rationale: Number of distinct voices across staves.

ctu_discovery_score_mean.rationale: Mean discovery score of extracted Characteristic Thematic Units.

ctu_discovery_score_std.rationale: Standard deviation of CTU discovery scores.

ctu_span_length_mean.rationale: Average measure span of retained CTUs.

ctu_span_length_std.rationale: Standard deviation of CTU measure spans.

ctu_melodic_abs_interval_mean.rationale: Mean absolute melodic step within CTU motifs.

ctu_melodic_interval_diversity.rationale: Interval entropy / distinct interval ratio within CTUs.

ctu_rhythm_ratio_abs_deviation_mean.rationale: Rhythmic ratio deviation within CTU structures.

ctu_texture_attack_mean.rationale: Mean simultaneous attacks during CTU playback.

ctu_texture_attack_std.rationale: Standard deviation of texture density in CTUs.

ctu_pitchclass_entropy.rationale: Pitch class entropy restricted to CTU boundaries.

ctu_pitchclass_max_share.rationale: Prominence of modal tonic / dominant pitch class in CTUs.

ctu_active_voice_stream_mean.rationale: Average polyphonic voice count within thematic units.
